skills.title: Read and build numbers to 100 000
skills.description: Read, write, and build numbers up to 100 000 in words, digits, and expanded form. Break them apart by place value, like 24 336 is 2 ten thousands, 4 thousands, 3 hundreds, 3 tens, and 6 ones.

skills.title: Compare and order to 100 000
skills.description: Tell which of two big numbers is greater or less by checking the biggest place that is different. Put numbers up to 100 000 in order from least to greatest or greatest to least.

skills.title: Equal fractions, improper and mixed
skills.description: Show that different fractions can be the same amount, like 2/3 and 4/6. Switch between improper fractions and mixed numbers, like 7/4 and 1 and 3/4.

skills.title: Compare and order fractions
skills.description: Tell which fraction is bigger, even when they are more than one whole. Use pictures, number lines, or the benchmark of one half to put fractions in order.

skills.title: Read and compare hundredths
skills.description: Read, show, compare, and order decimals like 3.25. The second digit after the dot counts hundredths, and 3.2 is the same as 3.20.

skills.title: Round decimals to the tenth
skills.description: Round a number like 56.23 to the closest tenth, which is 56.2. If it is exactly halfway, like 56.25, round up.

skills.title: Fractions, decimals, and percents
skills.description: Show that a fraction, a decimal, and a percent can name the same amount, like 1/4, 0.25, and 25%. Percent means out of 100.

skills.title: Operation rules and checking answers
skills.description: Use rules like order, grouping, and splitting a number to make problems easier. Use opposite operations to check answers, even in problems with two steps.

skills.title: Times and divide facts to 12 × 12
skills.description: Know all the times facts up to 12 × 12 and the divide facts that go with them. Know that zero times anything is zero.

skills.title: Times 0.1 and 0.01, estimate decimals
skills.description: In your head, multiply a whole number by 0.1 or 0.01, like 400 × 0.1 = 40. Round decimals to make a quick guess for adding and subtracting.

skills.title: Add and subtract big and decimal
skills.description: Solve problems by adding and subtracting whole numbers up to 100 000 and decimals to hundredths. Line up the places, and trade when you need to.

skills.title: Add and subtract same-size fractions
skills.description: Add and subtract fractions that have the same bottom number, like 3/8 + 12/8. You are just adding or taking away pieces of the same size.

skills.title: Multiply two-digit by two-digit
skills.description: Multiply numbers like 24 × 38 using a rectangle split into four parts. Then do it with the written method and see how the two match.

skills.title: Divide by a two-digit number
skills.description: Divide a three-digit number by a two-digit number, like 234 ÷ 18. Use a rectangle or the written method, and decide what to do with any leftover.

skills.title: Multiply and divide by unit fractions
skills.description: Find 4 × 1/3 by adding four one-thirds. Find 4 ÷ 1/3 by asking how many thirds fit in 4 wholes.

skills.title: Equal ratios and rates
skills.description: Make ratios and rates that mean the same thing by scaling up or down, like 6 green to 1 yellow is 12 green to 2 yellow. Use tables and drawings to help.
